digest.component_or_area: development process audit reconciliation and decision framework
propositions: Six process improvement proposals from bleakish-stational-cob must be evaluated against prior audits, janitor work, architecture decisions, and implementation outcomes to identify whether they should be reaffirmed, refined, reconsidered, or deferred.

The escaped-defect metadata recommendation should be refined to expand automatic detected_by stamping at automated-filer boundaries and measure coverage by creation_channel rather than globally requiring or backfilling unverifiable history.

Deterministic plan preflight should extend P1-P11 only for recurrent mechanically decidable failures demonstrated in persisted review data with offline replay, explicit false-positive ceilings, and fail-open behavior; semantic LLM review should remain for architecture and tradeoffs.

Completion-failure classification must first derive historical first-non-PASS sidecars offline into six categories (code defect, unmet AC, missing test, plan gap, environment error, verifier failure) and validate classifier agreement before adding durable reason codes.

Risk-tiered review should pilot risk reporting without merge enforcement, evaluating security/store/concurrency surfaces, diff breadth, and plan-review failures before choosing blocking thresholds, because the project has no routine human Gerrit review and caused_by attribution is noisy.

Maintainership/reviewer breadth recommendation must be heavily refined to focus on autonomous-assurance independence and operational continuity—monitoring provider diversity, correlated failures, and CI-versus-LLM disagreement—rather than adding mandatory human approval in an autonomous governance model.
